items.title: Reggie Watkins interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, May 22, 2018
items.q: Duke Ellington lived long enough to understand that he was not just a successful band leader and composer/arranger, but also celebrated as a national treasure.

ctx.x: Because if you look at some of those old clips of shows where they’re introducing — of course the musicians were celebrated to a certain extent. On the other hand of course horrible discrimination and whatnot was going on in our country. But artistically they were being validated not only by their peers but by the media and by listeners in other countries. And if you were a jazz musician in the fifties and you went to Europe you would feel that sense of appreciation. You know, that maybe you aren’t getting in the…

I’ve seen many times the phrase jazz is America’s only original art form. And I sort of agree but then I think well what about the blues, and if we’re calling rock & roll art now, I guess what I’m trying to say is it’s wonderful that so many forms of music started here and then got spread around the world.
